title: Design System: Find the right care

display.purpose: Location and service at the head of the results.

wordmark.purpose: Product name next to the route mark.

components.name: Search action
components.description: The filled action beside the search fields.
components.css: .ds-filled { min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 25px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #104963); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent, #104963); color: #fff; font: 650 1rem/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filled:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #0a374c); } .ds-filled:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #176d90; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-filled:disabled { opacity: .7; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Phone action
components.description: The filled action alongside a facility result.
components.css: .ds-filled { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #104963); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent, #104963); color: #fff; font: 650 1rem/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filled:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #0a374c); } .ds-filled:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #176d90; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-filled:disabled { opacity: .7; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Replay action
components.description: The underlined action alongside the historical replay note.
components.css: .ds-replay { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--accent, #104963); font: 650 .875rem/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .2em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-replay:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--accent-hover, #0a374c); } .ds-replay:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #176d90; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-replay:disabled { opacity: .7; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Search field
components.description: A labeled location or care field.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Location<input class="ds-location" placeholder="City, state · PIN · latitude, longitude" required></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink, #172a34); font: 650 .9375rem system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-location { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--control, #68777b); border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #172a34); caret-color: var(--accent, #104963); font: inherit; font-weight: 450; } .ds-location::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #515e64); } .ds-location:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #176d90; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Language picker
components.description: The labeled native select in the masthead.
components.css: .ds-language { display: grid; width: fit-content; grid-template-columns: auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 4px 10px; color: var(--muted, #515e64); font: .8125rem system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-language-select { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 24px 9px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--control, #68777b); border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #172a34); font: 1rem system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-language-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #176d90; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Evidence disclosure
components.description: The native disclosure beneath a facility result.
components.html:
Evidence and source links
Virtue

Campus identity and pin need confirmation.
components.css: .ds-evidence { color: var(--ink, #172a34); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence summary { width: fit-content; padding-block: 8px; color: var(--accent, #104963); cursor: pointer; font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-evidence summary::marker { font-size: .8em; } .ds-evidence summary:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .2em; } .ds-evidence summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #176d90; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-source { margin-top: 8px; padding-block: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #c9cfcd); font-size: .9rem; } .ds-source p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #515e64); font-size: .875rem; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Facility row
components.description: A ruled result with name, distance metadata, and a status line.
components.html:
#1 Mayaganj Hospital (JLNMCH)

Bhagalpur · 1.6 km straight-line

Dialysis documented
components.css: .ds-facility { padding-block: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #c9cfcd); color: var(--ink, #172a34); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-facility h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font: 700 2rem/1.15 var(--display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif); letter-spacing: -.032em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-rank { margin-inline-end: .35em; color: var(--muted, #515e64); font: 650 .8125rem/1 system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0; vertical-align: .22em; } .ds-facility p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #515e64); font-size: .875rem; line-height: 1.55; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-result-status { margin-top: 9px; color: var(--accent, #104963); font-weight: 650; } @media (max-width: 650px) { .ds-facility { padding-block: 20px; } .ds-facility h3 { font-size: 1.625rem; } }

components.name: Emergency guidance
components.description: A bordered warning with an inline call link.
components.html:
Possible emergency

If this is happening now in India, call 112 now.
components.css: .ds-emergency { padding: 16px 18px; border: 1px solid #ad6b54; background: #fff3ed; color: var(--warning, #783a26); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-emergency h2 { margin: 0 0 5px; font-size: 1.125rem; } .ds-emergency p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-emergency a { color: inherit; font-weight: 700; text-underline-offset: .2em; } .ds-emergency a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #176d90; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Route mark
components.description: The outlined route mark paired with the wordmark.
components.css: .ds-mark { position: relative; display: inline-grid; width: 28px; box-sizing: border-box; aspect-ratio: 1; place-items: center; border: 1.5px solid var(--accent, #104963); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--accent, #104963); } .ds-mark::before { content: ""; width: 12px; height: 14px; background: currentColor; clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 74% 100%, 48% 56%, 0 40%); } @media (max-width: 650px) { .ds-mark { width: 22px; } }

narrative.overview:
The interface reads as a referral directory. A paper-white canvas, dark serif headings, petrol controls, and thin gray rules give location, care need, and facility names a clear order. A small route mark sits beside the wordmark.

Facility rows place the evidence status and its explanation beside the follow-up action. Supporting claims and source links open beneath the same result.
